summary.text: Russell Holmes is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 6th Suffolk District since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as certified financial planner and legislator, and he has served on the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Russell Holmes earned a bachelor's degree from Boston University in 1992 and a graduate degree from Northeastern in 2000, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as certified financial planner and legislator.
Ballotpedia also states that he has served as chair of the Mattapan Library Task Force and the Mattapan Economic Development Initiative.

He took office in the 6th Suffolk District in 2011; for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Operations, Facilities and Security Committee and as a member of the House Ways and Means Committee, the Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery Joint Committee, the Joint Committee on Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion, and the Ways and Means Joint Committee.
